rules.title: JUnit 5
rules.text: Write tests with JUnit 5 and parameterized tests for tables of cases.

rules.title: Fluent assertions
rules.text: Use AssertJ assertions for readable failures.

rules.title: Mock boundaries only
rules.text: Use Mockito for external boundaries and prefer real objects otherwise.

rules.title: Testcontainers
rules.text: Test persistence against real databases with Testcontainers.
